summary:
The Monkey D. Luffy special art numbered ST01-012 comes from the side of the One Piece Card Game catalogue most casual buyers never touch: the starter-deck numbering block. ST01 is the Straw Hat Crew deck, the entry product built to put a playable Luffy list into a new player's hands, and ST01-012 is a Luffy card inside that block. Special-art treatments applied to starter-deck numbers are unusual precisely because the base card is common - the artwork upgrade is the whole scarcity story, and it produces the odd situation where a card from the cheapest product in the range becomes a genuine chase.

### Basic Info
*   **Main subject / card theme:** Monkey D. Luffy, captain of the Straw Hat Pirates
*   **Set or product (catalog label):** 2023 Awakening of the New Era Special Art
*   **Card number:** ST01-012
*   **Language version(s):** English catalog entry
*   **Rarity / treatment:** Special art
*   **Set label year:** 2023

### Community Pulse
The recurring question in threads about this card is simply which printing someone actually holds. The ST01 numbering points at the Straw Hat Crew starter block, while the catalog files this particular printing under an Awakening of the New Era-era special art label - so buyers cross-check the number against the label and the art treatment instead of trusting either on its own. That verification habit is the practical heart of the conversation. Running alongside it is the usual starter-deck condition problem: deck-sourced cards were handled by players before they were ever handled by collectors, so a high proportion of surviving copies carry play wear, and clean examples are harder to source than the low profile of the product would suggest. Collectors who specialise in Luffy runs treat this card as a completion piece - needed to close out a Luffy set, rarely bought as a standalone position.

### Card Fun Facts
*   ST01 Straw Hat Crew was one of the game's launch starter decks, which means its numbering block predates most of the sets collectors think of as the game's core.
*   Special-art printings on starter-deck numbers invert the normal price logic: the cheapest product in the range can host one of the harder cards to find in clean condition.
*   Because the card number and the catalog set label point at different parts of the release history, this is one of the cards where reading the label literally is the correct behaviour.

### Summary (TLDR)
ST01-012 special-art Luffy is a starter-deck-numbered card carrying an upgraded art treatment, filed by the catalog under a 2023 Awakening of the New Era special art label. Its market runs on printing verification and on condition scarcity - deck-sourced stock was played with first and collected second.
